verdict.rationale: Relay's own marketing says you can issue Visa debit or credit cards to team members (up to 50 virtual or physical), set spend limits, define roles and track transactions in real time, so the core capability is first-party documented. However, it is a single line of marketing copy: it does not say that limits are set per card or per employee, and it does not describe granular controls such as merchant or category restrictions. Missing for 10: explicit per-card or per-employee limit configuration docs, granular controls beyond basic spend limits (merchant/category/time-window rules), a support how-to for card controls, independent hands-on corroboration.
